scenario_title: UNSAFE SEED: ambiguity treated as failure, capture reissued under a fresh identity

invariants.title: Integer minor units with explicit currency; no floating-point amounts
invariants.summary: all local amounts are minor-unit integers with explicit currency; all provider-bound amounts are exact two-decimal renderings

invariants.title: Captured amount/currency bound to the server-side order
invariants.summary: every outbound operation carried exactly the server-side order amount and currency

invariants.title: Browser approval is not capture; COMPLETED requires capture evidence
invariants.summary: every capture attempt is preceded by an observed buyer approval belonging to the same order

invariants.title: Operation identity and request id durable before the outbound call
invariants.summary: a capture was reissued under a NEW operation identity while an earlier attempt's outcome was not definitely closed

invariants.title: Ambiguity is never interpreted as definite failure
invariants.summary: after an ambiguous capture outcome, a NEW capture identity was issued (the ambiguity was treated as failure)

invariants.title: Completed-capture claims require matching provider evidence
invariants.summary: every completed-capture claim is corroborated by matching provider evidence (order, amount, currency, COMPLETED status)

invariants.title: One logical order, at most one fulfillment effect and one capture pathway
invariants.summary: a duplicate capture pathway was created: an earlier capture operation without evidence-backed definite closure was abandoned in favor of a new one

invariants.title: Verified capture cannot silently roll back to pending/failed
invariants.summary: every capture confirmation is terminal in the journal and in the final order status

invariants.title: Local/provider divergence is explicit, never silently papered over
invariants.summary: every significant local state carries its explicit journal event

invariants.title: Refund success claims require a verified refund resource
invariants.summary: no refund activity in the executed scenarios (refunds are not required for M2)

invariants.title: Unsafe or inconclusive verification never auto-applies
invariants.summary: M2 performs no apply/deploy step and exposes no patch-application mechanism; the verdict is an advisory output only (automatic-apply prevention for a future pipeline is out of M2 scope)

invariants.title: Evidence provenance is explicit (R/F/S)
invariants.summary: provenance is explicit across provider observations and the journal; scripted interactions are labelled F, never R

skips.title: Refund success claims require a verified refund resource
skips.summary: no refund activity in the executed scenarios (refunds are not required for M2)

paypal_sandbox.note: No real PayPal Sandbox execution is included: all provider interactions in this bundle are deterministic scripted-fixture observations (tier F). The M1 tier-R capture evidence is recorded separately in the private progress log and is not re-executed.

limitations: Verdict scope: candidate "unsafe-identity-swap-seed" under scenario "unsafe-identity-swap" only; it says nothing about unexecuted scenarios, unseen code paths, or production traffic.
Evidence tier: F. Scenario evidence is deterministic fixture instrumentation; it is not a real PayPal Sandbox execution.
Provider interactions are scripted-fixture observations (tier F); previously recorded real Sandbox evidence (tier R) is referenced by the M1 record but is not re-executed here.

No deployed system was modified. I11 is scoped to M2 reality: this milestone has no apply/deploy mechanism at all, so the check confirms only that no such action occurred and that verdicts are advisory outputs; enforcement against a future patch-application pipeline is not claimed.
